name: slime_item_sideways
description: A piston pushes a slime block east from under an item. Slime does not carry entities sideways: the item is left behind and drops onto the piston arm. When the piston retracts, its head drags the item into the moving head; the item, inside a block, heads out of it (moveTowardsClosestSpace), the retracting piston pushes it back out of its base, and it drops to the floor.
